## Contribution rules for thanos-io/thanos

- For non-trivial changes, open or find an issue and agree on the approach first. (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L30)
- Disclose AI assistance in the PR description. Example: "This PR was written in part with the assistance of generative AI" (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L69)
- Do NOT add `Assisted-by`, `Co-developed-by` or similar AI commit trailers. (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L71)
- Do NOT list an AI tool as co-author (no `Co-authored-by: <AI>` lines). (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L71)
- A human must write replies to review comments; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L79)
- A human must write commit messages; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L75)
- Sign off every commit (`git commit -s`) with the human's name and email, never the agent's. (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L154)
- Be able to explain every line of the change yourself. (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L77)
- Review and verify AI output yourself before asking for review. (https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L77)
